annotations.title: Pitch, headlap and gauge sanity check

description: Checks a roof covering type against the pitch, the headlap and the batten gauge: is the pitch below the typical minimum for that kind of tile or slate, is the headlap enough for the exposure, does the gauge leave the headlap you want. Returns overall (ok_subject_to_maker_data, check_with_maker or fail), each check with its working, and what to confirm. Indicative: always confirm against the maker's data for the exact product. Pass maker_min_pitch_deg and maker_min_headlap_mm from the data sheet to check against those instead. Typical call: {"covering":"natural_slate","pitch_deg":25,"headlap_mm":75,"exposure":"severe"}.

covering.description: Roof covering. concrete_interlocking: Concrete interlocking tile (large format); clay_interlocking: Clay interlocking tile; clay_pantile: Clay pantile (traditional); plain_tile: Plain tile, clay or concrete (265 x 165 mm); natural_slate: Natural slate (500 x 250 mm default); fibre_cement_slate: Fibre cement slate (600 x 300 mm default).

exposure.description: Exposure to wind-driven rain. Default moderate.

maker_min_headlap_mm.description: Minimum headlap from the maker's data sheet, if known.

maker_min_pitch_deg.description: Minimum pitch from the maker's data sheet, if known.

tile_length_mm.description: Unit length, mm (to check the gauge).

trade.description: Optional. The roofer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to put the contractor on risk notes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Ridge Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Hilltop Roofing".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme or trade body the business is registered with (CompetentRoofer is the roofing scheme run by the NFRC).
